profile.address: Avenida San Jorge / San Jorge Etorbidea, 81, Pamplona/Iruña, Navarra, Spain
profile.reading: This is the CPD (Centro de Procesamiento de Datos) operated by NASERTIC, the public technology company of the Government of Navarra, Spain, located at NASERTICs Pamplona/Iruña facilities on Avenida San Jorge/San Jorge Etorbidea 81. The original data center was delivered in 2017 as a container based, prefabricated modular facility built to Tier III availability standards, completed in just five months against a typical 18 to 36 month timeline for comparable projects, at an investment of 1.28 million euros. The project was developed jointly by NASERTIC, Aquads Technologies, and Schneider Electric, and was designed to operate alongside NASERTICs existing data center for redundancy. It won an Innovation Prize from Data Center Market magazine in the category of best containerized CPD with Tier III availability. In December 2023 the Navarra government declared a major expansion and modernization of the CPD an investment of regional interest, or inversion de interes foral, a designation that grants the project preferential and expedited treatment across Navarra public administration procedures. Technical documentation for the 2024-2025 expansion phase describes a 1,258 square meter technical space with 270 racks rated at 100 kW each, an initial electrical supply of 20 megawatts expandable to 40 megawatts across five 4 megawatt transformers, a 2N configured uninterruptible power supply rated at 1 megawatt, and four separate thermal cooling circuits including a condensation loop, direct liquid cooling, rear door heat exchangers, and ambient cooling supported by 17 megawatt rated evaporative cooling towers. The facility also includes VESDA smoke detection, a custom building management system, and a smart water management system. NASERTIC describes the center as supporting digital services for Navarra citizens, the regional administration, and its public enterprises, managing what the company has described as roughly 11 billion data records for the region.
profile.research_note: Corrected 2026-09-04: a prior 2026-09-02 batch note incorrectly flagged this as a non-US facility out of scope for a US-focused audit. This registry has since processed many international operators (TIM Italy, Nabiax Spain, KIO Networks Espana, Aruba s.p.a Italy, Cineca Italy, and others), so that scope note was stale and has been superseded; this facility is treated as in scope like any other row returned by the standard query. Researched fresh this session using NASERTICs own newsroom pages plus a project engineering page from cooling contractor Climava. Two OSM rows share this name and near-identical coordinates (this one and osm:node/13608563509); the same sourced content is applied to both since no basis was found to distinguish an original 2017 container unit from a separate expansion building at the same site.
